layout_note: Full-page intaglio ENGRAVING (evangelist author-portrait of S. Marke) facing the opening of his Gospel. NO scripture body[], NO running header, NO folio number. The only letterpress/engraved TEXT is a faint engraver's signature within the plate and a two-line Latin emblematic couplet in the cartouche beneath the image. 'THE HOLY GHOSPEL ... ACCORDING TO ... MARKE' book-heading is NOT on this leaf — it follows on the next page (~p106), which the p104 catchword 'THE' anticipates. Modern watermark 'www.fatimamovement.com' + papal-keys logo bottom-left excluded (digitization artifact).

apparatus.description: Author-portrait of S. Marke (St. Mark the Evangelist): a haloed, bearded man seated at a slanted writing desk, quill in his lowered right hand, writing his Gospel; his emblem the winged lion crouches at right beside him; a leaded/latticed window at upper left, a hanging curtain at upper right, an inkwell and a small dish set on the desk in the lower right. Baroque engraving.

apparatus.position: lower_right within the plate (on the desk edge, above the cartouche)
apparatus.note: faint cursive engraver's mark; reading low-confidence — could be 'Piqvet.'/'Picquet.' and the verb 'incidit'/'ſculpſit'.

apparatus.face: engraved italic/cursive (long-ſ present, e.g. adeſt, inſtar, ſit)
apparatus.text:
Forma Leonis adeſt MARCO: inſtar namq; leonis
Rugit et exclamat: ſit via plana Dei.
apparatus.note: Latin emblematic couplet identifying Mark with the lion (his evangelist symbol): 'The form of a lion is present to Mark: for like a lion he roars and cries out — let the way of God be made plain' (alluding to Mark 1:3, 'parate viam Domini'). 'MARCO' set in small capitals. 'namq;' = 'namque' with the '-que' abbreviation stroke.

uncertain.note: very faint cursive within the plate; the surname and verb are both low-confidence at 400 DPI.
the '-que' abbreviation on 'nam' — the abbreviation mark could be a semicolon-form (namq;) or a tilde (namq̃); rendered 'namq;'.

glyph_counts.note: counted by script over apparatus[].text (caption: adeſt, inſtar, ſit); not hand-counted.

method: visual-multimodal-read of 400 DPI raster (.gt-rasters/scripture-matthew-28-p0105.png); cartouche and signature regions cropped and upscaled 3-6x. Caption Latin verified for sense against Mark 1:3; engraver signature flagged uncertain due to faint intaglio line at scan resolution.
confidence: high on the cartouche couplet; low on the engraver signature; image described not transcribed.
